funds.name: Certain
funds.role: Capital preservation tier — purchasing power first
funds.thesis: Short duration by design, with T-bills held as a real position rather than a residual. Gold and the Swiss franc carry the store-of-value job. No trend sleeve, no listed property, no long Treasuries.

holdings.name: Developed ex-US, currency-hedged
holdings.rationale: Xtrackers MSCI EAFE Hedged Equity. The hedged vehicle is the point: it delivers developed ex-US equity without the dollar bet that an unhedged fund forces the holder to take alongside it.

holdings.name: Swiss franc deposit
holdings.rationale: Invesco CurrencyShares Swiss Franc — a franc deposit in listed form. This is how the store-of-value mandate is expressed outside the dollar.

holdings.name: Gold bullion
holdings.rationale: SPDR Gold MiniShares — allocated physical gold at a lower expense ratio than the larger legacy vehicle, which matters for a position held for decades.

holdings.name: Broad commodities, optimised roll
holdings.rationale: Invesco Optimum Yield Diversified Commodity. The optimised roll matters: a naive front-month commodity fund bleeds return to contango, and that cost is a large part of why commodity sleeves have historically disappointed.

holdings.name: Broad TIPS
holdings.rationale: Schwab US TIPS, tracking the broad Bloomberg TIPS index. The real-return holding: principal is indexed to CPI, so the payoff is in purchasing power.

holdings.name: Intermediate Treasuries
holdings.rationale: Schwab Intermediate-Term Treasury — the same duration bucket from a second issuer.

holdings.name: 0–3 month T-bills
holdings.rationale: iShares 0–3 Month Treasury Bond. Effectively zero duration and zero credit risk: cash as a funded position that earns the short rate.

holdings.name: Intermediate IG credit
holdings.rationale: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Corporate Bond. Investment-grade spread at a duration close to the Treasury sleeve, so the credit decision is not confounded with a duration decision.

holdings.name: Intermediate Treasuries
holdings.rationale: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Treasury, tracking the 7–10 year part of the curve: enough duration to respond to a growth shock without becoming a long-rate position.

holdings.name: US large-cap core
holdings.rationale: Vanguard S&P 500. The core US equity holding: the deepest and cheapest access to the large-cap market, tracking an index with clean history back to 1993.
